cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Apologise for starting me behind the shed before you congratulate the winner. I taught you to line up runners where they can see the course.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You read the results correctly, at least. I spent ten seconds finding the race. Start your apology there, not at the finish line.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep 'mistake'. Add that it gave me a worse start than everyone else. You can distinguish intention from effect; we practised that when you first set a course.

reason: Give the exact Drive a concrete request, relevant pupil habit and responsive B4 development. Improve weak endings into things A actually needs B to do, without changing playable card wording.
